To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) KadoP allows the construction and querying of a distributed repository of XML resources; (2) The repository is constructed by a peer-to-peer overlay network of nodes, each of which stores a part of the repository; and (3) KadoP's query language is based on ActiveXML, which allows the user to query the repository using XML documents and ActiveXML queries.

(a) KadoP allows a peer to publish its XML data and Web services to a distributed repository, (b) KadoP provides a query language that allows users to query the distributed repository, and (c) KadoP's query processing paradigm allows a peer to query the distributed data without requiring it to maintain the data.
KadoP is a novel approach to building a distributed infrastructure for XML warehousing.
